description_for_human: Search job postings across LATAM job boards (Computrabajo, Bumeran, OCC, ZonaJobs, Laborum) in a single API call.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to search job postings across Latin American job boards including Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru, and Uruguay. Returns deduplicated, salary-normalized results. Best for recruiters, HR-tech builders, and AI agents researching the LATAM job market.
